message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Go

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:

  lint:
    # Run only on pull requests: only-new-issues needs a PR diff, and a full
    # run on main would report the existing backlog of issues.
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v7
        with:
          version: v2.1
          only-new-issues: true

  ubuntu-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: Run Go Vet
        run: |
          go vet ./...

      - name: Run Go Fmt
        run: |
          files=$(go fmt ./...)
          if [ -n "$files" ]; then
            echo "Please run gofmt on these files ..."
            echo "$files"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Build
        run: go build -v ./...

      - name: Run Unit Test
        run: go test -count 1 -v ./...

      - name: Run Benchmark Test
        working-directory: ./benchmark
        run: go test -count 1 -v -bench=. ./...

  windows-test:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: Run Go Vet
        run: |
          go vet ./...

      - name: Build
        run: go build -v ./...

      - name: Run Unit Test
        run: go test -count 1 -v ./...

      - name: Run Benchmark Test
        working-directory: ./benchmark
        run: go test -count 1 -v -bench=. ./...",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Go CI pipeline with lint, ubuntu-test, and windows-test jobs. Every job checks out code, sets up Go, and runs Go commands (vet, build, test, benchmark, golangci-lint) that repeatedly fetch module dependencies, but no dependency cache is present. The repository has go.mod and go.sum, satisfying the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE preconditions (repeated dependency fetching is measurable; cache inputs include the lockfile and environment). The matching experiment (batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9) added actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on runner OS plus hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') and reported maintained success with 6.06% elapsed savings. Applying the same minimal cache step after checkout/setup-go and before Go commands preserves all existing build/test coverage and required checks without adding network access, secrets, or privileged actions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
